title: Club Assenbly
summary: 6 RCBHS had a Club Assembly at Bellisima Banquets on this day. AG Rtn Malvika Sukhani was the chief guest of this meeting.
description: 6 RCBHS had a Club Assembly at Bellisima Banquets on this day. AG Rtn Malvika Sukhani was the chief guest of this meeting. Club President and other Rotarians gave an overview of the current/ new projects and other activities of the club. AG Malvika ji appreciated the impactful social work being done by the club. She particularly praised the Club’s efforts in procuring CSR funding for its flagship projects.
